title: ui: the derived record layout's ungrouped bucket has no header, so its fields read as part of the group above it — under a collapsed group they look hidden in that group
body:
Found by a downstream app on the published 18.4.0 packages (steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm#66; the app has since given its fields declared groups in PR #68, so nothing downstream waits on this).

## Symptom

On a record page / drawer whose object declares field groups, fields with no `group` render in a section **with no header** after the last declared group. When that last group is collapsed (e.g. `crm_account`'s 「系统 / System」), the ungrouped fields sit directly under its collapsed header and read as its contents; users take them for system fields or miss them. Measured on `crm_account` in zh-CN: 基本信息 · 联系信息 · 归属与状态 · 财务信息 · 系统 (collapsed) · *(no header)* 业务线 | 国内/出口 | ….

## Producer

`packages/spec/src/data/field-group-layout.ts` `deriveFieldGroupLayout` pushes the trailing bucket `{ collapse: 'none', fields: ungrouped }` with no `key` / label (lines ~65–77 document "Absent = ungrouped bucket"), and the console renders it without a heading. The contract only says "a default bucket after the declared groups".

## Why fix at the default

Every app that extends an object it does not own (an extension cannot declare `fieldGroups`) or leaves a field ungrouped hits it; asking each app to group every field to dodge a render default is the per-tile tax AGENTS.md-style rules ask to fix upstream.

## Suggested fix shape (for the lane to judge)

Give the ungrouped bucket a translatable default heading (e.g. "Other" / 「其他」, with a translation slot like the groups' `_sections` labels), or render it before the collapsed trailing groups; either way, never directly under a collapsed group without its own header.

Dedupe words: ungrouped bucket header · deriveFieldGroupLayout trailing section · collapsed field group headerless section.
